mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_category (parent_id, category_name, sort_order, icon, tenant_id, status) VALUES (#{parentId}, #{categoryName}, #{sortOrder}, #{icon}, #{tenantId}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM sys_category
AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT c.*, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_category child WHERE child.parent_id = c.id AND child.status = 1
AND (child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR child.tenant_id IS NULL)
) AS has_children FROM sys_category c
c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1
AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.*, 0 AS has_children FROM sys_category c
c.category_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') AND c.status = 1
AND (tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR tenant_id IS NULL)
ORDER BY c.category_name ASC, c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_category SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
